inlines.v: HE'ARTILY, adverb [from hearty.] From the heart; with all the heart; with sincerity; really. I heartily forgive them. 1. With zeal; actively; vigorously. He heartily assisted the prince. 2. Eagerly; freely; largely; as, to eat heartily
